# Component provenance

x264 commit0480cb05fa188d37ae87e8f4fd8f1aea3711f7ee (GPL); libyuv commit2e65a61dffeb6ab9dd5dd363ccede11770957b73 (BSD/PATENTS). Fetch upstream sources at the exact commits in dependency-revisions.json; upstream archives are not duplicated here. Kernel provenance is recorded in src/kernel/. Our JNI/capture sources and build scripts are in src/capture and scripts. Existing copyright headers and the licenses directory apply.

Android base: AOSP16 Raspberry Pi5, KonstaKANG2026-04-28. Original upstream Android/firmware notices remain in the image. FFmpeg/Raspberry Pi SAND decoder correction and allocator correction sources are supplied separately under src/android/scripts. Proprietary app APKs and the ARM32 protocol SDK are distinct binary components; this repository does not relicense them or claim their source implementation is included. Complete redistribution review is pending before public publication.
